study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Hua et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Adjustment of Regional Cortical Thickness Measures for Global Cortical Thickness Obscures Deficits Across the Schizophrenia Spectrum: A Cautionary Note About Normative Modeling of Brain Imaging Data

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract states clear objectives and hypotheses: to empirically demonstrate that covarying for global thickness severely underestimates regional thickness abnormalities and to test how global-thickness covariation versus ICV adjustment affects detection of deficits across schizophrenia-spectrum groups. It explicitly describes examining global/regional correlations and group differences with and without global-thickness covariation, which clarifies the purpose in the context of normative modeling.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text:
"We empirically demonstrated that this statistical approach severely underestimates regional thickness dysmorphology in psychiatric disorders... We examined global and regional thickness correlations, global thickness group differences, and regional thickness group differences with and without global thickness covariation."
"...analytic tools for conducting age- and gender-normative modeling incorporate global covariation... we statistically demonstrate how this approach leads to erroneous conclusions..."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: This study builds normative z-score models using healthy controls in two datasets. Eligibility criteria for healthy controls are described (recruitment source and diagnostic screening), and final HC sample sizes are reported. However, explicit image quality/motion/data-completeness standards and specific reasons for exclusion (e.g., QC failures) are not detailed.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text:
"Healthy control (HC) individuals were recruited from the local UCSF community and did not meet Axis I diagnostic criteria as determined by the SCID... All participants were required to be in good physical health, fluent in English, and between 12-35 years old."
"HC... individuals were scanned at one of three sites... as part of the Human Connectome Project–Early Psychosis (HCPEP). Diagnoses were determined by the SCID-5-RV."
"Study 1 included 90 healthy control participants... Study 2 included 56 healthy control participants..."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Normative (HC-based) regressions include age and gender as covariates; for the multi-site dataset (Study 2), site is included. They also explicitly compare models with and without global-thickness covariation to demonstrate its impact.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text:
"ROI thicknesses were regressed on age, gender, and site (only study 2 included site) in HCs..."
"Age, gender, site (for Study 2), and global thickness (for global thickness model) effects for each ROI were modeled in the HC group..."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: Data sources are specified: UCSF scanning center for Study 1 and HCP-EP (with NDA DOI) for Study 2. However, collection time periods are not described for newly collected data.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text:
"Study 1 [https://osf.io/2h8uj/] and study 2 (NIMH Data Archive [https://nda.nih.gov/], doi: 10.15154/kgg6-yf92/) data are available online."
"HC... were scanned at one of three sites... as part of the Human Connectome Project–Early Psychosis (HCPEP) study."

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Primary data collection protocols are described, including modality (structural MRI), sequence (T1-weighted MPRAGE), scanner manufacturer/field strength, and acquisition parameters. Multi-site secondary dataset scan parameters and harmonization procedures are also described.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text:
"Siemens 3T TIM TRIO... T1-weighted MPRAGE... TR=2,300 ms, TE=2.95 ms, flip angle=9°, FOV=256 mm, slice thickness=1.20 mm."
"Siemens Prisma 3T... identical scan sequences: TR=2,400 ms, TE=2.22 ms, FOV=256 mm, slice thickness=0.80 mm... MRI phantoms were scanned repeatedly..."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing software is specified (FreeSurfer) for computing ROI cortical thickness, and ROIs follow the Desikan-Killiany atlas. However, detailed pipeline steps and explicit QC procedures are not described.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "Global mean cortical thickness and ROI thicknesses... were computed using FreeSurfer (ROIs are numbered... listed with assigned numbers in Table S2)."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The normative regressions are fit in the HC group and used to compute adjusted z-scores; there is no mention of a partitioning strategy (e.g., hold-out test set or cross-validation) where model performance is assessed on held-out healthy individuals.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "ROI thicknesses were regressed on age, gender, and site... Resulting parameter estimates were used to derive predicted ROI values for each participant..."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: Two separate datasets are analyzed, each with its own HC-based regression; the study does not apply a single normative model to an independent external healthy dataset for validation.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "Study 1 included HCs, CHR-P, ESZ... Study 2 included HCs, NAff-P, Aff-P..."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical approach is specified: per-ROI linear regression in the HC group with covariates (age, gender, site), with/without global thickness, followed by z-score transformation. However, software/libraries for model fitting and specific settings beyond the formula are not reported.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "Age, gender, site (for Study 2), and global thickness... effects for each ROI were modeled in the HC group... y_i = β0 + β1*age + β2*gender + β3*site + β4*global thickness + e_i... Regional cortical thickness values were transformed to adjusted z-scores..."

nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.reason: The paper does not report quantitative model performance metrics for the HC-based regressions (e.g., explained variance, prediction error, calibration or coverage). RMSE appears only as a scaling term in the z-score formula, not as a reported evaluation metric.
nm9_model_performance_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Regional cortical thickness values were transformed to adjusted z-scores... dividing by the standard error of regression... z-score = (observed - predicted) / RMSE."

nm10_characteristics_reference_cohort_ea.reason: No data partitioning (e.g., train/validation/test or cross-validation) is reported; per the item guidance, this criterion is not applicable when no partitioning is performed.

nm11_reproducibility.reason: Data availability is stated (OSF for Study 1; NDA DOI for Study 2) and preprocessing software (FreeSurfer) is specified. However, software/library versions and analysis code or trained models are not provided.
nm11_reproducibility.supporting_text:

"... ROI thicknesses were computed using FreeSurfer..."

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: Eligibility and diagnostic criteria are described for CHR-P, ESZ, NAff-P, and Aff-P groups; general exclusion criteria are listed. Final sample sizes are reported. However, explicit imaging quality standards and reasons for exclusions due to imaging/QC are not provided.
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text:
"CHR-P participants met Criteria of Psychosis-Risk Syndromes... ESZ individuals met criteria... Healthy control (HC) individuals... did not meet Axis I diagnostic criteria..."
"Inclusion/exclusion criteria included... (list)... HC individuals had no history of psychiatric hospitalization and were not taking psychiatric medications."
"Study 1 included 90 HC, 51 CHR-P, 78 ESZ... Study 2 included 56 HC, 83 NAff-P, 30 Aff-P."

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: Analyses adjust deviation scores for demographic/site covariates via the HC regression (age, gender, site). The paper does not report incorporating clinical covariates such as medication status, illness duration, or symptom severity into the deviation analyses.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: "ROI thicknesses were regressed on age, gender, and site (only study 2 included site) in HCs to model the effects of normal aging, gender, and site."

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: Deviation scores (norm-adjusted z-scores) are defined and used to compare groups, implying directionality as deviation from healthy expected values. However, explicit interpretation of sign and magnitude, and quantitative thresholds for categories (e.g., |Z| > 1.96) are not provided. Clinical implications are discussed conceptually in terms of how global-thickness adjustment can obscure disease-related effects.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text:
"Regional thickness values were transformed to adjusted z scores... by subtracting predicted values from observed values and dividing by the HC model standard error of regression... Adjusted z scores represent each participant's deviation from the value expected for an HC of the same age, gender, and site."
"... regional thickness deficits in schizophrenia spectrum groups were attenuated or eliminated with global thickness covariation... This statistical approach results in erroneous conclusions..."
